lede: The county's Board of Review and Planning Commission will hear a presentation Tuesday on Colorado's new Low Energy and Carbon Code — building standards that could reshape how structures get approved in the box canyon. Beyond that, it's a light week for government meetings with most agendas still unavailable. The Livable Telluride Kick-Off Party happens Wednesday at KOTO, along with a "Forever Wild" film screening celebrating protection of the valley floor.

notable.stake: New building codes could change approval standards for local construction
